anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Through a mirror, in a riddle.
Quoted: counted the blood of the covenant a common thing.

choices.why: Bones are the wording; flesh is the thoughts from it.

pass_a_gloss: the wordings becoming his bones, and the fleshes the thoughts from the wording, on which as is likely stepping we see in a riddle and through a mirror the things after these, and of blood the faith of the gospel of the new covenant, as the apostle witnesses saying thus: And having thought the blood of the covenant common — by which blood, by the faith, having been anointed we shall flee the destroyer.
pass_b_english: the words becoming his bones, and the thoughts from the wording the flesh — on which, as is likely, we step and see the things after these in a riddle and through a mirror — and the blood the faith of the gospel of the new covenant, as the apostle bears witness: "And having counted the blood of the covenant a common thing." (1 Corinthians 13:12) By this blood, by faith, having been anointed, we shall escape the destroyer (Hebrews 10:29) (Exodus 12:23) (Hebrews 9:20).
